_README: EE 513 Project 1. Copy this file into your repository as results.json and replace every value with your own measurement. Each entry is [value, uncertainty] in the units named by the key. Use null for anything you did not measure; do not delete keys, and do not invent an uncertainty you cannot defend.
camera: iPhone 16 Pro Max back camera 6.765mm f/1.78
dynamic_range_criterion: DR = log2(S_max / S_min) with S_max = white level - black level and S_min = the read noise (the signal equal to the noise floor, i.e. SNR = 1 counting read noise only); read noise from the intercept of a pair-difference photon transfer fit below 10% of the span. Equivalently 65.6 dB as 20 log10(S_max / S_min). The exact SNR = 1 point, which includes the signal's own shot noise, gives 10.80 stops.
